_comment: Optional — only needed for live-scrape features (default for live:true products, geo-proxy, live discovery, --add). The base catalog lookup (/farenheit spotify, --category, --all, --cached) works with no MCP servers configured. Browser-automation zip mode (Amazon/Instacart/DoorDash/insurance/home-services, Method B in the intra-US zip section) needs its own Playwright-based MCP server too — not included here since there's no single standard public package for it; bring your own.
